text: Vel Tech Multi Tech Engineering College campus features modern infrastructure including smart classrooms equipped with Wi-Fi connectivity, LCD projectors, and digital boards. The campus has central air-conditioning in key academic blocks. The college has multiple academic blocks housing classrooms, laboratories, faculty offices, and seminar halls.

The central library has a collection of over 50,000 books, 3,000+ journal subscriptions (print and digital), and access to online databases including IEEE Xplore, Springer, NPTEL, and DELNET. The library has a digital section with 50+ computers for online research, a reading hall with 200+ seating capacity, and operates from 8 AM to 8 PM on working days.

The college auditorium has a seating capacity of 1,000+ and is equipped with professional sound systems, LED screens, and stage lighting. It hosts college events, seminars, workshops, and cultural programs. Additionally, there are two seminar halls with 200+ capacity each for department-level events.

The campus has 24/7 Wi-Fi connectivity with high-speed internet access (100+ Mbps leased line). All academic and hostel areas are covered under the Wi-Fi network. The IT infrastructure is managed by a dedicated networking team ensuring uninterrupted connectivity for students and faculty.

Other facilities include a dedicated parking area, canteen serving hygienic meals, a stationery shop, a bank ATM on campus, photocopy and printing center, and a fully equipped first-aid center. The campus is CCTV-monitored with 24/7 security personnel for safety.
